cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)
project(vikit_common)
find_package(ament_cmake REQUIRED)
find_package(Eigen3 REQUIRED)
find_package(OpenCV REQUIRED)
find_package(Sophus REQUIRED)
add_library(vikit_common SHARED src/pinhole_camera.cpp src/math_utils.cpp src/vision.cpp src/performance_monitor.cpp src/robust_cost.cpp)
target_compile_features(vikit_common PUBLIC cxx_std_17)
target_include_directories(vikit_common PUBLIC $<BUILD_INTERFACE:${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include> $<INSTALL_INTERFACE:include> ${OpenCV_INCLUDE_DIRS})
target_link_libraries(vikit_common PUBLIC Sophus::Sophus Eigen3::Eigen ${OpenCV_LIBRARIES})
install(TARGETS vikit_common EXPORT export_vikit_common LIBRARY DESTINATION lib)
install(DIRECTORY include/ DESTINATION include)
ament_export_targets(export_vikit_common HAS_LIBRARY_TARGET)
install(FILES LICENSE-NOTICE.txt DESTINATION share/${PROJECT_NAME})
install(DIRECTORY licenses DESTINATION share/${PROJECT_NAME})
ament_package(CONFIG_EXTRAS cmake/dependencies.cmake)
